title: Prototype Standup Summary
text: Decision: proceed with revised motor mount CAD. Action item: Alex validates connector clearance by Friday.

title: EVT Readiness Review
text: PCB thermal instability remains an EVT risk. Firmware tuning reduced rise but reliability validation still needs margin.

title: Supply Chain Review
text: Dependency: supply chain is waiting on finalized BOM before releasing bracket PO. Lead time risk affects prototype build.

title: Customer Demo Scope Review
text: Decision: keep customer demo scope to navigation, lift actuation, and safe stop. Inventory scanning is deferred.
